_comment: Timing units for design modules with no flops, which check-cg's units (test/**/cg-units.json) do not cover: one module at one parameterisation each, for tools/check-ngd.py. These are OOE's combinational modules at test/ooe/depth.sh's parameters (the RS classes' sizes, CCV_SECTIONS + 1 resources for the RCU class, CCV_MIU_PIPES for the MIU class, CCV_TIER1_WARPS slots), held here by TI until OI moves them into test/ooe/ngd-units.json.
